newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank sets 3 pct repo. key rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank sets 3 pct repo. key rates steady.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank on Wednesday called for bids on two-week securities repurchase agreements at a fixed and unchanged rate of three percent, adding it would leave its key interest rates steady.
The central bank said bids have to be in by 0800 GMT on Friday.
Last week the bank allotted 6.21 billion schillings in repos, filling five percent of bids.
Austria's discount rate stands at 2.50 percent, its emergency Lombard borrowing rate at 4.75 percent, and its Gomex money market rate at 3.40 percent.
